node.statement: Write Z=(Z_ij)_{1<=i,j<=n}, X=(X_j)_{1<=j<=n}, and Y=(Y_i)_{1<=i<=n}. By the definitions of matrix amplification, matrix dot-product, and the amplified column sesquilinear form in the H-CB datum, ((Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X)_i=sum_j Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_ij)(X_j), (Z dot X)_i=sum_j Z_ij dot X_j, (Y^dagger dot Z)_j=sum_i Y_i^dagger dot Z_ij, and <Y,W>_n=sum_i <Y_i,W_i> for every amplified column W.
